[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Every notification-panel tab wears an icon[/bold #D7AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust core carries a per-tab icon[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-icon[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-icon: add `icon` to the core's notification tab record, donated by [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the newest member row that declares `action_data.panel_icon`, mirroring [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the existing color-donation rule, with defensive validation and tests; [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]land and release it in sase-core.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Icon resolution chain and configuration[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]icon-chain[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]icon-chain: add `resolve_notification_tab_icon` to the tab-style module [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with its four-rung resolution chain, the built-in key and kind glyph [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tables, the `ace.notification_tabs.*.icon` setting, its JSON-schema [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]entry, and the bundled defaults.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Gates must declare their panel's icon[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gate-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-contract: add the required `presentation.panel_icon` gate field, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]project it into notification `action_data` as a protected key, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]update both bead gate producers that declare `panel: beads`.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Render icons in the tab strip and indicator[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]render[dim] · [dim][/dim]after icon-chain[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]render: draw the icon in the modal tab strip and in every indicator [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chip, replace the snoozed `z` suffix with its glyph, and make every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]width measurement cell-aware so a two-cell icon cannot desync tab click [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ranges or tooltip alignment.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adopt the released core and verify end to end[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]core-floor[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-icon, icon-chain, gate-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-floor: raise the `sase-core-rs` floor to the release carrying the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tab icon and verify a gate-declared panel icon reaches the tab strip and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the indicator through the real core.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Documentation and the sase_gate skill contract[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs-skill[dim] · [dim][/dim]after render, gate-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs-skill: document tab icons, the reshaped indicator badge, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]new configuration field, and teach the bundled sase_gate skill source [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that a declared panel requires a panel icon.[/#D7D7AF]
